### Observed differences

- A01 was not observed at all in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces). In the later window it runs in about 46 in 100 traces (92 of 200), just under once per trace on average, recurs within the same trace in roughly a quarter of the traces containing it, and sits early-to-middle in the trace (median position about 0.38 of the trace length). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, A01's observed outgoing transitions lead to A05 in about 53 in 100 cases and to A10 in about 47 in 100; earlier, A01 had no observed outgoing transitions. [DIR001]
- Existing activities now route to A01: A05 previously sent all of its observed outgoing transitions to A10 and now splits them roughly 53 to 47 between A10 and A01; A06 went from all-to-A05 to roughly 52 to 48 between A05 and A01; A03's share going to A05 fell from about 51 to 16 in 100 while about 35 in 100 now go to A01; A11's share going to A05 fell from about 49 to 25 in 100, with about 24 in 100 now going to A01. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]
- The partner activities changed from running without A01 to running with it: A01 now co-occurs with A05 and with A10 in about 46 in 100 later-window traces (never before), with A06 in about 33 in 100 (never before) and with A03 in about 28 in 100 (never before); A03, A05, A06 and A10 no longer appear in any trace without A01, whereas before they appeared alone in roughly 32–53 in 100 traces. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004]
- Previously adjacent steps are now often one step further apart: A05→A10 within one step in about 56 in 100 cases before versus about 24 in 100 after (two steps about 25); A06→A05 within one step about 76 before versus about 34 after; A06→A10 moved from two steps (about 76) to three steps (about 61); A03→A10 moved from two–three steps to three–four steps; milder spreading appears for A03→A05 and A05→A06. [LAG002, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG001, LAG003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

Screening qualified 18 control-flow items where about 0.17 would be expected by chance in an unchanged process, so these differences as a whole are far beyond what random re-splits of stable behaviour produce. The evidence supports the possibility that A01 now runs as a step inserted between existing activities: in the later window A01 executes in about 46 in 100 cases (it was not observed earlier), placed early-to-middle in the trace; A03, A05, A06 and A11 each send roughly a quarter to a half of their observed outgoing transitions to A01, and A01 leads on to A05 or A10; previously adjacent pairs such as A05→A10 and A06→A05 are now frequently separated by one extra step; and A03, A05, A06 and A10 now appear only alongside A01. Occurrence, directional, relational and distance evidence all point to the same restructuring. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, LAG002, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006]

An important competing explanation remains: zero participation in the earlier window only shows that A01 was not observed there, so the evidence cannot prove A01 was newly added rather than previously too rare to appear in 200 traces — although 0 of 200 traces before versus 92 of 200 after makes pure sampling fluctuation implausible. The exact placement is also not pinned down: A05 and A01 follow one another in both directions and A01 recurs within traces, so a single fixed insertion point cannot be distinguished from several insertion points or a repeated block. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR003, REL002]

Other differences: A10's position moved slightly later (mean position about 0.48 to 0.51 of the trace length) and its participation dipped from about 53 to 46 in 100 traces; this is small and consistent with the insertion above rather than an independent change. [POS002]
